dell_0b00_bq_table.note_on_0xD470_range: 0xD470..0xD497 belongs to RT1320 (rt1320-sdw.c:479), NOT RT1316. RT1316 BQ coefficients live at 0xC203..0xC252.

crossover_activation_bug.regcache_sync_hazard: 0xC200 is non-volatile in stock rt1316-sdw.c:166-180, so regcache_sync replays cached 0xC0 BEFORE 0xC203..0xC252 in ascending order. Fix: mark 0xC200 volatile and pulse explicitly after writing coefficients & 0xC202.

slot_tags_0x3004_0x3005.nibble_order_conflict_warning: Windows comments say 'LV=2, LI=0' for 0xA0 / 'LV=6, LI=4' for 0xE4 (implying high nibble=V, low=I), whereas Linux rt1316-sdw.c:435-438 defines Left V Tag = bits 2:0, Left I Tag = bits 6:4 (opposite nibble order). Actual slot identity (I vs V) is UNKNOWN until live IPC4 PCM 3 capture.

digital_gain_0xD001_0xD004.module_lane_safety_caveat: Direction of 0xD002/0xD004 is NOT measured on hardware yet. Basic_cmd.txt:7 labels 0xA9 '(30 L, 0dB=2.8Vrms)' while Advance_cmd.txt:7 labels 0xCA '(30 L, -6dB=2Vrms)'; read literally, 0xA9 could be up to +4.0 dB louder than 0xBF. Both C60F=0x05 and D002/D004=0xA9 MUST remain gated behind P4 250ms thermal deadman interlock and verified via faint measurement first.

forbidden_registers.name: Software reset
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Resets chip state; Linux/Windows write different reset bits (0x02 vs 0x01); volatile.

forbidden_registers.name: DC detection enable
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Hardware speaker DC-offset protection; disabling risks voice-coil burnout.

forbidden_registers.name: Sine generator control
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Internal test-tone generator; accidental enable injects full-scale sine directly into drivers.

forbidden_registers.name: Silence detection control
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Controls silence-detect auto-mute; volatile (live reads 0x87 status bits).

forbidden_registers.name: Software PDB / K_R0 cal mode
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Power-down / R0-calibration mode switch; unsafe outside guarded calibration sequence.

forbidden_registers.name: Silence detection & S3 hold
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Silence detection / hold S3 control; volatile (live reads 0x87).

forbidden_registers.name: SoundWire clock detection
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: SoundWire clock loss protection; volatile; disabling risks runaway PWM on clock stop.

forbidden_registers.name: HV mute behaviour (Rev B)
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Bit 3=0 forces HV_Mute=1 when muted (Rev B silicon protection).

forbidden_registers.name: HV_POW_SPK_PRO enable
forbidden_registers.safety_rationale: Bit 0 enables high-voltage output-stage speaker power protection; MUST stay 0x05.
